The plan has three distinct reasons to change: (1) the `pre_plan_gates.py` constants + hash infrastructure changes if the locked-field schema changes; (2) the PreToolUse hook + marker pattern changes if the lock-enforcement mechanism changes; (3) the `/clarification` SKILL.md step sequence changes if the process design changes. These are three separate change drivers, so three implementation slices are appropriate, plus a closing verification slice.
desired_outcome: The 4 locked Discovery fields (Desired Outcome, Guiding Policy, Desired Solution, OMTM) are protected from silent mutation across all phases; any attempt to edit them is rejected by code with a pointer to the re-entry path.
